name: ShadowBench

formats.code: Minimal application tree (Python or Node, plus optional agent config).
formats.identity: Okta GET /api/v1/apps JSON export, status ACTIVE.
formats.lowcode: n8n workflow export JSON (id, name, nodes, connections).
formats.saas: Slack admin approved-app record JSON, with workspace id.
formats.cloud: JSONL record in the AWS inventory dump shape (agent or lambda).
formats.endpoint: Linux home-directory fragment with vendor config paths.
formats.network: JSONL DNS log row with src_ip, query and ts.
formats.runtime: osquery processes JSON array (name, path, cmdline, pid).

label_rule: Labels are the planted facts in truth.json. No evaluated tool produced them.
